chunks: He said: 'No, you cast first.' Then it seemed to him, by their magic, that their ropes and staffs were running.

key_terms.يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ: it seemed to him / illusion appeared to him

ai.seo_question: What did the magicians' ropes and staffs appear to do to Moses in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this verse highlights the psychological state of the magicians and Pharaoh's court, where their own sorcery created a temporary illusion (khayal) of movement, momentarily deceiving their eyes before the divine truth manifested. This moment of awe serves as a precursor to the revelation of Allah's power, emphasizing that human magic is merely an illusion compared to the reality of the Prophetic miracle. The verse underscores the concept of 'takhayyul' (illusion) in contrast to 'haqq' (truth), a key theme in understanding the confrontation between divine authority and earthly power.
